mapper.select: SELECT d.key_code AS keyCode, d.key_name AS keyName FROM t_sr_dim_channel d WHERE d.status = 1 AND d.is_deleted = 0 AND (d.tab_type = #{tabType} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{tabType}, d.tab_type) > 0) ORDER BY d.sort_no, d.key_code

SELECT t.strategy_code AS keyCode, t.strategy_name AS keyName FROM t_sr_strategy t WHERE t.tab_type = #{tabType} AND t.is_deleted = 0
AND t.channel = #{channel}
AND 1 = 0
AND t.strategy_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT m.metric_code AS keyCode, m.metric_name AS keyName FROM t_sr_dim_metric m WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND (m.tab_type = #{tabType} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{tabType}, m.tab_type) > 0) ORDER BY m.sort_no, m.metric_code

SELECT k.metric_code AS metricCode, k.metric_name AS label, k.value AS value, k.unit AS unit, k.qoq AS trendQoQ, k.yoy AS trendYoY, k.icon AS icon, k.sort_no AS sortNo FROM t_sr_kpi_summary k WHERE k.tab_type = #{tabType} AND REPLACE(k.stat_month, '-', '') = REPLACE(#{statMonth}, '-', '') AND k.is_deleted = 0
AND k.strategy_class = #{strategyClass}
AND k.strategy_class = '全部'
ORDER BY k.sort_no, k.id
SELECT MAX(REPLACE(k.stat_month, '-', '')) FROM t_sr_kpi_summary k WHERE k.tab_type = #{tabType} AND k.is_deleted = 0

SELECT REPLACE(k.stat_month, '-', '') AS month, k.value AS value, k.qoq AS qoq, k.unit AS unit FROM t_sr_kpi_summary k WHERE k.tab_type = #{tabType} AND k.metric_code = #{metricCode} AND k.is_deleted = 0
AND k.strategy_class = #{strategyClass}
AND k.strategy_class = '全部'
AND REPLACE(k.stat_month, '-', '') <= REPLACE(#{statMonth}, '-', '')
ORDER BY k.stat_month DESC LIMIT 12

choose.when:
SELECT s.strategy_id AS strategyId, s.strategy_code AS strategyCode, s.strategy_name AS strategyName, s.channel AS channel, d.key_name AS channelName, s.big_category AS bigCategory, s.small_category AS smallCategory, s.consult_count AS consultCount, s.consult_count_qoq AS consultCountQoQ, s.retain_count AS retainCount, s.retain_count_qoq AS retainCountQoQ, s.retain_rate AS retainRate, s.retain_rate_qoq AS retainRateQoQ, s.dispatch_count AS dispatchCount, s.dispatch_count_qoq AS dispatchCountQoQ, s.success_count AS successCount, s.success_count_qoq AS successCountQoQ, s.success_rate AS successRate, s.success_rate_qoq AS successRateQoQ, s.income AS income, s.income_qoq AS incomeQoQ FROM t_sr_strategy_period_summary_ctrl s LEFT JOIN t_sr_dim_channel d ON d.key_code = s.channel
and s.channel!='全部' and s.big_category !='全部' and s.small_category !='全部' and s.strategy_name!='全部' and s.strategy_id!='999'
ORDER BY
${orderByClause} s.success_count DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
choose.otherwise:
SELECT s.strategy_id AS strategyId, s.strategy_name AS strategyName, s.strategy_class AS strategyClass, s.channel AS channel, d.key_name AS channelName, s.big_category AS bigCategory, s.small_category AS smallCategory, s.original_cust AS originalCust, s.original_cust_qoq AS originalCustQoQ, s.push_count AS pushCount, s.push_count_qoq AS pushCountQoQ, s.usage_count AS usageCount, s.usage_count_qoq AS usageCountQoQ, s.usage_rate AS usageRate, s.usage_rate_qoq AS usageRateQoQ, s.reach_count AS reachCount, s.reach_count_qoq AS reachCountQoQ, s.target_conv_num AS targetConvNum, s.target_conv_num_qoq AS targetConvNumQoQ, s.target_conv_rate AS targetConvRate, s.target_conv_rate_qoq AS targetConvRateQoQ, s.product_conv_num AS productConvNum, s.product_conv_num_qoq AS productConvNumQoQ, s.product_conv_rate AS productConvRate, s.product_conv_rate_qoq AS productConvRateQoQ, s.expected_income AS expectedIncome, s.expected_income_qoq AS expectedIncomeQoQ, s.actual_income AS actualIncome, s.actual_income_qoq AS actualIncomeQoQ, s.reject_rate AS rejectRate, s.reject_rate_qoq AS rejectRateQoQ, s.reject_count AS rejectCount FROM t_sr_strategy_period_summary_ap s LEFT JOIN t_sr_dim_channel d ON d.key_code = s.channel
and s.channel!='全部' and s.big_category !='全部' and s.small_category !='全部' and s.strategy_name!='全部' and s.strategy_id!='999'
ORDER BY
${orderByClause} s.product_conv_num DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

choose.when:
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_sr_strategy_period_summary_ctrl s
AND s.channel != '全部' AND s.big_category != '全部' AND s.small_category != '全部' AND s.strategy_name != '全部' AND s.strategy_id != '999'
choose.otherwise:
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_sr_strategy_period_summary_ap s
AND s.channel != '全部' AND s.big_category != '全部' AND s.small_category != '全部' AND s.strategy_name != '全部' AND s.strategy_id != '999'

choose.when: SELECT p.strategy_id AS strategyId, t.strategy_code AS strategyCode, COALESCE(t.strategy_name, p.strategy_name) AS strategyName, COALESCE(t.strategy_name, p.strategy_name) AS name, t.strategy_level AS level, t.caliber AS caliber, t.iteration AS iteration, DATE_FORMAT(t.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS createTime, t.owner AS owner, t.status AS status, DATE_FORMAT(t.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(t.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate, p.channel AS channel, d.key_name AS channelName, p.big_category AS bigCategory, p.small_category AS smallCategory FROM ( SELECT strategy_id, strategy_name, channel, big_category, small_category FROM t_sr_strategy_period_summary_ctrl WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND channel!='全部' ORDER BY stat_month DESC LIMIT 1 ) p LEFT JOIN t_sr_strategy t ON t.strategy_code = #{strategyId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_sr_dim_channel d ON d.key_code = p.channel LIMIT 1
choose.otherwise: SELECT p.strategy_id AS strategyId, t.strategy_code AS strategyCode, COALESCE(t.strategy_name, p.strategy_name) AS strategyName, COALESCE(t.strategy_name, p.strategy_name) AS name, t.strategy_level AS level, t.caliber AS caliber, t.iteration AS iteration, DATE_FORMAT(t.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS createTime, t.owner AS owner, t.status AS status, DATE_FORMAT(t.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(t.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate, p.channel AS channel, d.key_name AS channelName, p.big_category AS bigCategory, p.small_category AS smallCategory FROM ( SELECT strategy_id, strategy_name, channel, big_category, small_category FROM t_sr_strategy_period_summary_ap WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND (tab_type = #{tabType} OR tab_type IS NULL) AND channel!='全部' ORDER BY stat_month DESC LIMIT 1 ) p LEFT JOIN t_sr_strategy t ON t.strategy_code = #{strategyId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_sr_dim_channel d ON d.key_code = p.channel LIMIT 1
